system.description: A Focus for a character who can become translucent and move through solid objects.

abilities.name: Light Step
abilities.description: Reduce the weight of your footprints enough to avoid pressure plates, and reduce falling damage by one wound severity.

abilities.name: Soft Whisper
abilities.description: Say something to a being within immediate range without anyone else hearing it.

abilities.name: Walk Through Walls
abilities.description: Slowly pass through physical barriers of level 5 or lower, perceiving while phased but unable to pass through energy barriers. Effort raises the maximum barrier level. Last action.

abilities.name: Defensive Phasing
abilities.description: Until a ten-minute recovery, gain an asset to dodge tasks as some attacks pass harmlessly through you. Action to initiate.

abilities.name: Phase Grasp
abilities.description: Phase a visible object within long range into your hands or immediate range; an object held or behind a barrier requires an Intellect attack. Action.

abilities.name: Slip Into Shadow
abilities.description: Use a successful stealth task to hide from a creature nearby. Effort hides from more creatures, and at tier 3 the base number of targets is three.

abilities.name: Faster Phase
abilities.description: Walk Through Walls becomes faster and uses a normal action instead of a Last action.

abilities.name: Phased Attack
abilities.description: Your attacks this turn ignore the foe's Armor; against a PC, their block attempts fail.

abilities.name: Phase Door
abilities.description: Phase through adjacent and distant solid objects to travel within long range when no intervening barriers block the route. Effort extends the travel range. Action.

abilities.name: Phase Friend
abilities.description: Bring an ally within immediate range with you when using a phasing ability. Effort brings another ally.

abilities.name: Quick Phase
abilities.description: Walk Through Walls becomes much faster, or lets you phase up to 10 feet as a First action.

abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.description: Become unable to affect or be affected by normal matter or energy until a ten-minute recovery. Action to initiate.

abilities.name: Phase Foe
abilities.description: Touch and phase a creature of level 4 or lower as if using Untouchable. Effort raises the maximum target level. Action.

abilities.name: Selective Phase Attack
abilities.description: Once each round, an attack using Phased Attack deals +5 damage.
